create_CategoricalIndex: create a CategoricalIndex from array-like data with optional categories and ordered flag
test_CategoricalIndex_equals: test if two CategoricalIndex objects contain the same elements considering order and categories
refactor_CategoricalIndex_map: refactor a CategoricalIndex by mapping its category values using a function or dict
build_CategoricalIndex_reindex: build a reindexed CategoricalIndex matching a target set of values
review_CategoricalIndex_contains: review whether a given key is contained in the CategoricalIndex
